description: Source code for OpenSSL BoringSSL project, implementing directory-based X.509 certificate lookup functions.

methods.name: X509_LOOKUP_hash_dir
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the directory-based X509 lookup method.

methods.name: dir_ctrl
methods.description: Handles control commands for directory lookup, such as adding directories.

methods.name: new_dir
methods.description: Initializes a new directory lookup structure.

methods.name: free_dir
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a directory lookup structure.

methods.name: add_cert_dir
methods.description: Adds a directory to the list of directories to search for certificates.

methods.name: get_cert_by_subject
methods.description: Retrieves a certificate or CRL by subject name from specified directories.
